product.name: Bluetile x Nike SB Dunk 'Black Marina White'
product.story: Designed in partnership with the South Carolina skate shop, the Bluetile x Nike SB Dunk 'Black Marina White' draws inspiration from the monarch butterfly. Fuzzy laces secure the upper, which combines a shimmering Pitch Blue leather base with coated black suede overlays at the forefoot and heel. The latter is de-stitched and features butterfly wing graphics printed on the interior side. A subtle hexagonal print covers a teal blue Swoosh that is raised to mimic the look of butterfly eyes. Orange embroidered detailing is found beneath the heel tab, marked with 'Blue' and 'Tile' on the left and right shoes. Underfoot, the translucent rubber outsole reveals a blue and orange gradient that denotes the setting sun.

hits.story_html: The Nike SB Dunk Low 'Songkran' delivers a festive colorway honoring Thailand's New Year festivities. Inspired by the papaya salad known as Som Tum, beige and dark tan hues are executed on the canvas and suede upper, featuring a woven texture meant to resemble bamboo rice baskets. The shoe's classic lines are accented with contrast red stitching that matches the Nike SB logo on the woven tongue tag. 'Nike' is inscribed in Thai lettering on the back tab, finished in metallic silver in a nod to the steel pots used to cook sticky rice. Inside the shoe, a rice bag graphic adorns a foam insole enhanced with a Zoom Air unit embedded in the heel.

hits.name: Nike SB Dunk Low 'Filbert'
Nike SB Dunk Low 'Green Noise Watermelon'
Nike SB Dunk Low 'Muni Fast Pass'
hits.story_html: The Nike SB Dunk Low 'Muni Fast Pass' takes inspiration from the monthly swipe cards that were formerly issued by San Francisco's mass transit system. A silver iridescent Swoosh adorns the split color-blocked nubuck upper, featuring contrasting Baroque Brown and Safety Orange coloring between the front and back half. A custom Nike SB graphic graces the sockliner, fitted with a springy Zoom Air unit in the heel. Underfoot, a grippy rubber outsole in Wolf Grey provides superior board feel.

name.value: Travis Scott x Nike SB Dunk Low PRM QS 'Cactus Jack - Special Box'

hits.story_html: Made in collaboration with the Astroworld rapper, the Travis Scott x SB Dunk Low PRM QS 'Cactus Jack' Special Box treats the retro low-top to a radical design overhaul. The upper features a brown suede toe box, tartan plaid textile quarter panel and tear-away paisley textile on the forefoot and heel overlay. Braided rope laces give the sneaker a distinctly rustic look. This pair arrives in a special Nike SB box finished in the same plaid and paisley patterns found on the shoe.
hits.name: Travis Scott x Nike SB Dunk Low PRM QS 'Cactus Jack - Special Box'
Note x Nike SB Dunk Low 'Brew & Biscuits'
hits.story_html: The Note x Nike SB Dunk Low 'Brew & Biscuits' delivers an inaugural collaboration with a Manchester skate shop founded in 1999. Inspired by the classic British repast of tea and biscuits, the beige suede upper can be customized with interchangeable textured Swooshes in pink and brown. An all-over graphic print covers the textile collar lining and interior tongue, marked with an illustrated 'strength of brew' guide. Note Manchester branding is embroidered on the back tab. Underfoot, the rubber outsole on the left shoe features a tea-ring stain.

hits.name: Nike SB Dunk Low 'Muni Fast Pass Lightning'
Nike SB Dunk Low 'Marty McFly'
hits.story_html: The Nike SB Dunk Low 'Marty McFly' features a colorway inspired by Marty McFly's Nike Air Mags in 1989's Back to the Future Part II. The design combines a Wolf Grey upper with a white Swoosh, speckled detailing on the white midsole, and a Light Retro translucent outsole. Released in May 2015, the sneakers also include insole graphics resembling Marty McFly's hoverboard.

The Beyond x Nike SB Dunk High 'White Ivory Sand Dune' celebrates the 20th anniversary of the Finnish skate shop. The collaborative release is inspired by Finnish architect and designer Alvar Aalto, whose kidney-shaped curved-bottom pools helped to give rise to California's empty-pool skateboarding scene in the '70s. Channeling Scandinavian functionalism, the high-top sports a suede upper in ivory and light tan. The birch-toned Swoosh nods to Aalto's iconic furniture, while the blue patent leather collar mimics the look of glazed ceramic tiles. The rust-brown rubber outsole symbolizes the red brick commonly found in Aalto's building designs.
hits.name: Beyond x Nike SB Dunk High 'White Ivory Sand Dune'

hits.story_html: The Thomas Campbell x Nike SB Dunk High 'What The' is a collaboration between Nike SB and multimedia artist Thomas Campbell, who served as the art director for the skate film Nike SB Chronicles Vol. 3. Inspired by the film’s poster art, the design features a quilt-like upper. Released in July 2017, 100 pairs of the sneakers were also sold with a special edition shoebox at Atlas Skateboarding in San Mateo, California.

hits.name: Nike SB Dunk Low 'Nasty Boys'
hits.story_html: Nike teamed up with UNheardof and Anonymous to release the SB Dunk Low ‘Nasty Boys’ in September 2015. Done up in the red and grey road colors of the Cincinnati Reds, the shoe pays tribute to the team’s ‘Nasty Boys’ relief corps of Norm Charlton, Rob Dibble and Randy Myers, who were instrumental in the Reds’ 1990 World Series championship over the Oakland A’s. The Bay Area team received its own high-top Dunk to complete the thematic pack.

Released in November 2016, this Nike SB Dunk Low 'Pink Box' colorway was based on Nike SB’s 2005 pink sneaker box. It features a 3M reflective pink leather upper with a black Swoosh, a white midsole, and a black rubber outsole. It also comes with an embossed shoebox on the heel.
hits.name: Nike SB Dunk Low 'Pink Box'
Concepts x Nike SB Dunk High 'Stained Glass'
hits.story_html: The Nike Concepts x SB Dunk High 'Stained Glass' features a church-inspired stained glass window graphic on the upper with a black Swoosh. It also comes with Concepts branding on the tongue, a white midsole, and a black outsole. Released exclusively at Concepts stores in July 2015, the ‘Grail Pack’ also included the Nike Dunk Low Pro SB 'Holy Grail' and the Nike SB Stefan Janoski Max ‘Mosaic.’

The Nike SB Dunk High Premium Hemp 'Waffle' features a waffle-inspired textured tan upper with a dripping syrup graphic on the Swoosh. Released in April 2016, the sneaker also includes chicken and waffles graphics on the insoles and a translucent gum sole.
hits.name: Nike SB Dunk High Premium Hemp 'Waffle'

hits.story_html: Released in December 2016, the Nike SB Dunk High 'Purple Box' sneaker gets a colorway inspired by classic Nike SB shoe boxes circa 2006–2007 (and also a subtle nod to the MF Doom colorway). The sneaker’s sleek black and ‘Purple Haze’ upper incorporates premium suede and faux ostrich leather, with 3M reflective detailing on the piping. Further homage is paid to the brand's iconic shoe boxes with a cartoon-like collage shoe box design on the inner lining.
hits.name: Nike SB Dunk High 'Purple Box'
Nike SB Dunk Low 'Saffron Quartz'
Concepts x Nike SB Dunk Pro High 'Ugly Christmas Sweater' 2017

name.value: Concepts x Nike SB Dunk Pro High 'Ugly Christmas Sweater' 2017

hits.story_html: Released in December 2017, this Dunk Pro High 'Ugly Christmas Sweater' is a follow-up to Concepts’ 2013 ‘Ugly Christmas Sweater’ colorway. The upper features snowflakes, presents, snowmen, gingerbread men, and mistletoe with a blue Swoosh, blue laces, and a red liner. The shoe also comes with dual branding on the tongue, a white midsole, and a blue outsole.

Nike SB renders the classic SB Dunk High Pro with a cherry blossom motif. The white canvas upper is given an all-over floral pattern, with faint red and black hues recalling the famous Japanese tree. The high-top design incorporates a padded heel collar for added protection and comfort, while the Zoom Air-infused insole is included for cushioning.

tags.name: Alias
tags.description:
Peer-to-peer sneaker and streetwear resale marketplace. Access real-time
listings, size-specific pricing, and live offers directly from Alias.

tags.name: Cached GOAT
tags.description:
Cached GOAT sneaker data for products, prices, and marketplace insights. Data is at most 24 hours
old, with faster performance at a fraction of the cost.

tags.name: Cached Shopify
tags.description:
Cached Shopify store catalogs with products, variants, prices and availability. Data is served
from our cache for fast, low-cost queries; only Kicks Crew is cached for now.

tags.name: Cached StockX
tags.description:
Cached StockX sneaker data for products, prices, and marketplace insights. Data is at most 24 hours
old, with faster performance at a fraction of the cost.

tags.name: Chrono24
tags.description:
Real-time access to Chrono24, the largest marketplace for luxury watches. Search new and pre-owned
listings from dealers and private sellers worldwide, with localized prices, condition, shipping
costs and seller details.

tags.name: Flight Club
tags.description:
Consigned sneaker market intelligence from one of the industry's founding pioneers. Access real-time
physical store inventory, localized retail pricing, and variant-level availability across premium
consignment tiers through a low-latency feed.

tags.name: GOAT
tags.description:
Granular visibility into global secondary footwear and apparel markets. Extract variant-specific
pricing, regional ask/bid spreads, and localized inventory metadata through a unified stream that
bypasses complex security layers.

tags.name: Kicks Crew
tags.description:
Direct access to Kicks Crew's storefront. Real-time product search, pricing and availability across
its catalog of new and resale sneakers.

tags.name: Kream
tags.description:
The premier gateway to South Korea’s leading resale ecosystem. Access hyper-localized market trends,
real-time KRW valuations, and premium sneaker/apparel transaction histories from East Asia’s
dominant marketplace.

tags.name: Nike
tags.description:
Programmatic access to Nike’s global digital storefronts. Monitor stock levels, track regional price
shifts, and extract deep product catalog metadata across Nike.com with high-throughput reliability.

tags.name: Poizon
tags.description:
Cross-border sell-side intelligence for East Asia’s top resale platform. Tailored for the US region
with deep access to real-time sales streams, historical volume, and merchant liquidity data built to
spot high-margin arbitrage opportunities.

tags.name: Shopify
tags.description:
High-velocity orchestration for decentralized commerce data. A unified bridge for real-time
inventory tracking, multi-store product synchronization, and storefront metadata, bypassing standard
rate limits via a private gateway.

tags.name: SNKRS
tags.description:
Real-time monitoring for high-heat Nike releases and upcoming drops. Track localized SNKRS launch
calendars, draw statuses, stock feeding updates, and backend product metadata before they hit the
frontend.

tags.name: StockX
tags.description:
High-frequency market intelligence for the world’s largest secondary marketplace. Access real-time,
SKU-level price streams and historical sales normalized into a structured JSON feed.

tags.name: Yahoo Finance
tags.description:
Institutional-grade financial data delivery. Query, filter, and stream real-time equities, ETFs,
indices, and currency pairs directly from Yahoo Finance with zero-lag execution.
